senses.gloss: श्वैत्र्य श्वैत्र्य, i. e. श्वित्र + य, n. Leprosy, Man. 11, 51.

स्वैर स्वैर (from स्व and ईर्),
 I. adj.
 1. Self-willed, Pañc. 31, 3; of one's own accord, Rām. 3, 52, 27 (without the permission of her husband); unrestrained.
 2. Slow, or refractory, Nal. 21, 13; Sāv. 5, 98.
 3. Dependent on one's will, unimportant, MBh. 1, 1726; 1921; 3, 13573.
 II. रम्, adv.
 1. With one's own will, assent, Rām. 3, 52, 27; Utt. Rāmac. 29, 6; Kathās. 22, 99.
 2. Of one's own accord, Rājat. 5, 411.
 III. n. Wilfulness.
स्वैरता स्वैर + ता, and स्वैरिता स्वैरिता, i. e. स्वैरिन् + ता, f. Wilfulness, Lass. 2. ed. 19, 18 (र).

स्वैरिन् स्वैरिन्, i. e. स्वैर + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी, Self-willed, wanton, Lass. 42, 13.
 II. f. इणी, An unchaste woman, Pañc. 129, 1; Rājat. 5, 316.
